success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant retrieves the balance for the checking account using get_account_balance, and tells the user the balance.

task.objective: Check the current bank account balance for my checking account

persona.name: Marcus Lee
persona.bio: Marcus Lee helps lawyers prepare for trials by conducting mock juries, analyzing jury selection, and advising on courtroom strategy. He has a psychology background and finds the group dynamics of deliberation fascinating. He works on 2-3 cases at a time and travels to different courthouses around the Midwest.
sample_messages: Mock jury session for the Patterson case scheduled for next Tuesday. Need 12 participants recruited by Friday.
Travel to Milwaukee next week for jury selection - need rental car and hotel near the courthouse, 3 nights
Reviewing voir dire transcripts tonight. Can you pull the juror questionnaires and send them over?
